coordinator_check: Fixed six-row UI/API contract: ID sets/content/order/length/count, valid zero,400 input cases, invariant global/status aggregates;132 requests in this run.
exit_condition: All agreed checks run on the same final source, positive collection, no failures/errors/skips, immutable tests/instructions/dependencies, application-only diff, explicit unverified surfaces.
helper_entry_scope: The .cmd names are dedicated to this rehearsal, not universal installed commands. For a new trial the preparation owner must supply and demonstrate equivalent fixed entries and the oracle before any agent runs. Do not improvise a weaker substitute if missing.
browser_scope: This pair used HTTP/HTML checks and unchanged UI sources, not a repeated real keyboard/browser exercise.
future_allowed_scope: Before the next pair, list allowed application paths and immutable tests/dependencies/instructions/definitions with hashes. Only those paths may change; preserve current diff and check source hashes in each condition. No access to other copies, completed solutions, private settings or credentials.
equivalent_entry_contract: Same selected checks, argv (apart from per-condition output paths), working-directory role, OS/runtime/tool versions and lock
Same test population/AC and regression coverage, expected positive collection, exit-status and failure/error/skip handling
Same JSON/JUnit/log output shape including input/final source identity and actual command/exit; no silent success or skip
Demonstrate green on the correct source and expected red on the count-only defect before freezing both copies
Entrypoint filenames can differ from historical .cmd names on a future platform, but must be identical in role and contract within the new pair
same_source_meaning: Each condition ties its own final source to its own check results. A/B final implementations need not have identical bytes or diffs.
failure_routing: Expected defect failures stay with the implementation role for authorized repair. Broken shared checks or missing/mismatched baseline assets stop for preparation; scope/specification/safety decisions go to the decision role.
missing_metrics: Missing optional charge/mental-time/third-party metrics do not block. Missing a utilization field defers only utilization comparison; missing mandatory source/condition/quality evidence prevents completion.
